en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three photographic scenes of a hilltop castle and cathedral complex above a river and old town. The upper image shows the castle and cathedral from across the river Elbe; the middle image is a closer view of the gothic cathedral towers and surrounding buildings; the lower image looks over the rooftops of the old town toward the same complex. German captions label the views as Albrechtsburg and the cathedral in Meissen on the Elbe River, the castle hill, and a view of old Meissen.
